messages.subject: For Eisaku Ito | Energy systems, infrastructure and international stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Media Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Eisaku Ito, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Mitsubishi Heavy Industries' energy-systems and infrastructure portfolio operates across complex country, regulatory and public-sector environments where stakeholder strategy is fundamental to long-term execution. That interface closely matches my current work.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate senior institutional engagement and complex cross-functional matters across corporate and technical teams.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, international partnerships and infrastructure stakeholder strategy might support MHI's global priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Mitsubishi Heavy Industries.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
